name: ADRES TURKISH GENTS SALON
address: Al Raha Building - Shop 4 - Al Barsha First - Al Barsha - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
owner_description: Best Turkish Gents Salon in Dubai, professional team, best good quality products, perfect design. Only in Adres Salon you can find all personal care services for Gents.

reviews.author: Babur Yazici
reviews.text:
For Turkish people like me, finding the right barber is serious business—once you find a good one, you stick with them. My son and I have been regular customers at Adres Barber Shop for over 8 years.
After my previous barber Mehmet left, Yüksel took over, and he has been absolutely outstanding. Yüksel is super friendly, highly professional, and a true master of his craft. From the moment you walk in, you’re made to feel completely comfortable. The haircut and shave are always perfect, the shop is exceptionally clean, and the atmosphere is great with good conversation.
Highly recommended to anyone looking for top-tier service!

reviews.author: Bobur Sadriddinov
reviews.text: Hi, I came across ADRES Turkish Gents Salon and saw your amazing reviews — clearly a very popular place. I noticed you don’t have a strong website, and many top salons use one to attract more clients and manage bookings. Without it, you could be missing extra appointments. I help salons build clean, modern websites that bring in more clients. Open to a quick chat?
